rules.why: Commit alone, as the gate sees it: stage with git add in its own command, then `git commit -m "..."` with no paths, -a, cd, variables or another shell around it.
The plan has no passing verify: run('verify', 'run', {plan}) and commit when it passes.
A staged file changed after the verify: verify again, then commit.
The commit is outside the approved plan (another repository, or a file it does not name): unstage it, or present a revision.
